record.question: Who is the Vice Chairman of Mizoram State Planning Board?
record.explanation: Answer B: Lalkhama. Lalkhama was Vice Chairman of the Mizoram State Planning Board in the administration relevant to this March 2010 paper. The Finance Commission's record of its 22–24 April 2009 Mizoram visit lists him in that exact office; the Chakma Autonomous District Council's March 2011 ceremony record independently identifies the same incumbent. Historical/source note: Historical officeholder in the 2009–2011 administration, not a current claim. Reference: https://fincomindia.nic.in/asset/pdf/commission-reports/13fcreng.pdf; https://www.cadc.gov.in/cc/2011/03/13/aizawl-chakma-house-inaugurated-3-march-2011/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
